name: Scenario Paintball Top Down Shooter
author: CEFgoose
description:
Update 6/22/23

I Finished adding flag pull animations and functions for all applicable player states for both the left and right hand.

I am still very new to Unity, and I am happy for any input, suggestions or advice I can get.

Please leave a like and/or a comment below

Controls:
move with W,A,S,D,
mouse cursor -aim
right click - gun up/down
left click - shoots
Space - Sprint
M - change fire mode
Q- switch hands
Z- lean the player out to whatever hand has the gun, for snap shooting.
H- toggle Hydrate
P- swap to sidearm
C- Reload sidearm Co2
T- Pull Flag
1-8 - reload from select pod or magazine
